name: Fetterlock Fist
description: Punch with a fist that sets a fetter of sealed qi about the point struck.

name: Fetterlock Guard
description: Hold the guard in a fettered ring so a blow is caught and cannot be freed to strike again.

name: Fetterlock Step
description: Place each step inside a fetter of qi so the stance stays bound to the ground.

name: Fetterlock Turn
description: Loop a fetter over a striking arm and use it to swing the blow aside.

name: Fetterlock Press
description: Press a fettered seal on the foe's arm so the limb locks at the joint.

name: Fetterlock Pierce
description: Throw a hooked fetter through the guard and drag the foe's stance open.

name: Fetterlock Mend
description: Bind a wound shut with a fetter of sealed qi in yourself or an ally.

name: Fetterlock Cleanse
description: Bind a poison at the wrist and draw it out from yourself or an ally.

name: Fetterlock Snare
description: Leave a fettered seal in the ground that closes on the first foot to cross it.

name: Fetterlock Cover
description: Spread fettered seals over yourself and your allies that catch each blow and hold it.

name: Fetterlock Dominion
description: Close fetter and seal together on one foe so he cannot move or call a technique.

name: Sealbound Chains
description: streams: Sealing + Binding; weave chains of sealed qi round a foe and lock each link so he is held in every limb at once.

name: Wardseal Fist
description: Punch with a fist wrapped in a warding seal that holds the blow's force in the target.

name: Wardseal Guard
description: Hold a warding seal before the body that turns away a blow and keeps its mark.

name: Wardseal Step
description: Carry the warding seal along with each stride so the guard never lags the body.

name: Wardseal Turn
description: Let the warding seal take a strike on its rim and throw it off the line.

name: Wardseal Press
description: Press a warding seal onto the foe so his techniques lose their edge.

name: Wardseal Pierce
description: Thrust the edge of a warding seal through the guard into the flesh beneath.

name: Wardseal Mend
description: Set a warding seal over a wound to guard it while it knits in yourself or an ally.

name: Wardseal Cleanse
description: Set a warding seal over a curse so it cannot spread and draw it out slowly.

name: Wardseal Lock
description: Lock a warding seal on the foe's central channel so no technique can run through it.

name: Wardseal Cover
description: Spread a warding seal over yourself and your allies that takes heavy blows without a crack.

name: Wardseal Surge
description: Surge every warding seal outward at once in a ring of force that throws back all near foes.

name: Wardseal Aegis
description: Raise a great aegis of warding seals that no technique below its tier can pass or break.

name: Sealed Aegis
description: streams: Sealing + Protection; close a seal upon the ward itself so the aegis guards all within it and traps all who strike it.

name: Foldlock Fist
description: Punch into a fold of sealed space so the blow arrives a hand's width inside the guard.

name: Foldlock Guard
description: Fold a locked layer of space before the body so a blow reaches only the fold.

name: Foldlock Step
description: Step through a locked fold that shortens the ground between one footfall and the next.

name: Foldlock Turn
description: Fold a strike's path back on itself with a locked fold and turn it past the body.

name: Foldlock Press
description: Press a locked fold round the foe's arm so the limb is held out of reach of its own body.

name: Foldlock Pierce
description: Open a fold behind the guard and drive a sealed point through it.

name: Foldlock Mend
description: Fold the edges of a wound together in locked space until they join in yourself or an ally.

name: Foldlock Cleanse
description: Fold a taint into locked space and carry it out of the body of yourself or an ally.

name: Foldlock Snare
description: Leave a locked fold in the ground that swallows the first foot to enter it.

name: Foldlock Cover
description: Fold a cover of locked space over yourself and your allies that takes heavy blows into itself.

name: Foldlock Burst
description: Release every locked fold at once in a burst that tears the space round all near foes.

name: Foldlock Hold
description: Lock a whole fold of the field round the foe so he cannot step out of it.

name: Sealed Fold
description: streams: Sealing + Space; fold the field upon itself and seal the fold so the foes within are cut off from all that lies outside.

name: Ironclad Seal
description: streams: Sealing + Metal; cast the seal in a shell of living metal that closes over the foe and cannot be forced from outside.
